name: Planning permission status taxonomy
fact: Planning Data defines permissioned, not-permissioned and pending-decision as the three authoritative brownfield permission states.
gate: Status taxonomy supports fail-closed classification only; it is not a site decision.

name: Planning Data brownfield land register
fact: Current catalogue reports 37,666 brownfield-land records from 354 providers; collector last ran 20 July 2026 and all origin data are authoritative.
gate: Register inclusion is not planning permission, delivery or canonical parcel linkage.

name: National Housing Delivery Fund
fact: NHDF provides capital funding for infrastructure and land to support 1.5 million homes and prioritises additional housing supply.
gate: Programme availability is not a site award or signed funding agreement.

name: Homes England 2025-26 housebuilding statistics
fact: Homes England reports 42,433 starts and 40,332 completions in 2025-26, including 32,243 affordable completions.
gate: Programme-wide delivery is context, not parcel evidence.

name: ONS private rent and house prices July 2026
fact: Released 22 July 2026: England average rent £1,446 (+3.4% y/y); England average house price £292,000 (+2.3% y/y to May).
gate: Market context does not prove site viability or development probability.

name: UK House Price Index May 2026 official release
fact: Published 22 July 2026 with England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland price, volume and buyer-status data.
gate: HPI is area-market evidence, not parcel development evidence.

name: UK HPI May 2026 press summary
fact: England average price £292,000, +2.3% y/y; North East strongest annual rise at 5.9%, London -1.2%.
gate: Regional price movement is contextual and must not be converted directly to parcel score.

name: ONS construction output latest bulletin
fact: Released 16 July 2026: construction output +1.6% in three months to May 2026; new work +1.1%.
gate: GB construction trend is macro delivery context only.

name: ONS construction output dataset
fact: Current monthly construction dataset released 16 July 2026 with sector and revision information.
gate: Dataset supports trend checks, not parcel-specific construction status.

name: UK HPI release methodology and calendar
fact: Official UK HPI methodology/calendar confirms May 2026 publication on 22 July and June 2026 on 19 August 2026.
gate: Methodology/release control prevents use of unpublished June HPI figures.
